scripts.build:site: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs dist/site site
scripts.build:app: tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config vite.app.config.ts && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs ../src/datatrust/static/app app
scripts.build: npm run build:site && npm run build:app
